stem.text: A stationary wave on a stretched string is set up between two points P and T.

stem.alt: Stationary wave on a string drawn between a vibrator at the left and a grey wall at the right. Solid and dashed curves show the two extreme positions of the string. Labelled points: P at the left end, Q, R and S on the string, and T at the wall. Label: vibrator.

stem.text: Which statement about the stationary wave is correct?

A.text: Point R is at a node.

B.text: Points Q and S vibrate in phase.

C.text: The distance between P and T is three wavelengths.

D.text: The wave transfers energy from P to T.
